column_description: VARCHAR(20). Unique disaster event identifier. PK.
TIMESTAMP. Timestamp when the disaster event was recorded. Example: 2024-12-21 19:49.
HazType_enum. Type of the disaster (e.g., Wildfire, Earthquake). Possible values: Earthquake, Flood, Hurricane, Tsunami, Wildfire.
TEXT. Severity level of the disaster event. Possible values: Severity-1, Severity-2, Severity-3, Severity-4, Severity-5.
TEXT. Geographic area impacted by the disaster. Example: East Jeremy.
TEXT. Regional tag for categorization. Example: RC7250.
REAL. Latitude coordinate of the disaster center. Example: 51.203609.
REAL. Longitude coordinate of the disaster center. Example: 36.221141.
TEXT. Detailed report of the damage caused by the disaster. Possible values: Catastrophic, Minor, Moderate, Severe.

JSONB column. Summarizes the impact of the disaster including population effects and damage levels.
